title: Fennel Lantern
description: Four soft chord changes float over three slower bass changes. Their shared tones pass through bright and shadowed rooms before the rhythm finally aligns. At the end the chords fall away, leaving one plain F in the middle of the piano.
difficulty: Advanced four-against-three chordal pulse and voicing
technical_note: In the opening five bars, four dotted-quarter RH chords sound against three half-note LH dyads in each bar. Keep both streams even and quiet. The later shared rhythm should feel like a release of tension; the final single note is unaccompanied.

performance.note: Let the two chordal streams float across one another. Their later alignment feels calm; the solitary final F receives its full written length without an added fermata.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
